public_rationale: The searched records do not establish the broad valuation losses described by the forecast. Market and company financing disclosures provide countervailing context, but cannot defeat a forecast with no deadline. No event found meets the early-resolution rule.
limitations: Private fund marks and investor distributions are incompletely disclosed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI startup valuations will certainly suffer massive drawdowns and investors will take losses.

statement.excerpt: I believe that massive valuation drawdowns are a certainty. There are losses coming.

our_interpretation: Read the passage as predicting substantial losses across the AI startup holdings under discussion, rather than the ordinary failure of an isolated startup.
The subsequent reference to holdings retaining at most 50% gives context for the scale intended, but the quoted forecast itself supplies no exact threshold or affected share.
Investor losses require evidence about investor positions, including distributions and liquidation preferences; a lower headline company valuation alone can be misleading.
There is no deadline. The nearby reference to spending next year does not supply one for valuation losses.
criteria.support_condition: Documented substantial valuation declines across the relevant AI startup holdings, together with investor markdowns or realized losses, establish the predicted broad drawdown.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive terminal accounting of the relevant holdings establishes that the predicted losses did not occur. Continued funding or rising valuations over a finite interval cannot alone contradict an undated forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable financing or fund records showing substantial drawdowns and investor losses across the relevant holdings, with distributions accounted for; alternatively, a definitive terminal accounting of those holdings.
